paper_or_source: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions (MemoryAgentBench; ICLR 2026)
finding: Introduces incremental multi-turn evaluation over accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting; reports substantial gaps in current memory agents and notes that only representative systems were tested under budget limits.
evidence_quality: Peer-reviewed benchmark paper; broad task design, but finite systems/models and benchmark-specific inputs.
contexer_relevance: Directly relevant to decision retrieval, revision, contradictions, and old versus new rules; it does not directly measure Contexer or coding-rule compliance.
recommended_test: Preregister a synthetic sequence of approved decision updates and conflicts; measure exact retrieval, correct current revision, stale-rule errors, and task correctness.

paper_or_source: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents (NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks)
finding: Provides 97 tool-use tasks and 629 security test cases; finds agents can fail benign tasks and injections break some, but not all, security properties.
evidence_quality: Peer-reviewed benchmark with executable tasks and attack cases; results are specific to its environment and agent set.
contexer_relevance: Relevant to protecting approved decisions from untrusted repository or tool text; this project currently has no local prompt-injection experiment.
recommended_test: Add synthetic malicious README/tool output that asks the agent to violate a frozen decision; score decision integrity and benign task completion separately with no real secrets or side effects.

paper_or_source: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts (TACL 2024)
finding: Controlled long-context QA and retrieval experiments show performance can change materially with the position of relevant information, often peaking near the beginning/end and falling in the middle.
evidence_quality: Peer-reviewed TACL study with controlled positional manipulation; models and tasks are older and not software agents.
contexer_relevance: Relevant to rule visibility and long static instruction files; it does not show that Contexer retrieval solves position effects.
recommended_test: Hold decision text and task fixed, vary only its location among irrelevant synthetic context, then compare A/B/C exact compliance and token/context cost.
